name: vybe-go
description: VYBE GO — random video chat (Web + Mobile on Supabase)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @vybe/shared && npm run build -w @vybe/client-core
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @vybe/web
scripts.test:packages: npm run test -w @vybe/shared && npm run test -w @vybe/client-core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vybe/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vybe/client-core && npm run typecheck -w @vybe/web
